payload_snapshot.stem: The illustration below shows Singapore's four water sources: a reservoir fed by rain, a pipeline from Johor, a NEWater plant, and a desalination plant by the sea. Using the illustration, explain why Singapore invests in NEWater and desalination even though it buys water from Johor under an agreement that ends in 2061.

rubric.description: Independence from rain and other countries

payload_snapshot.model_answer: Singapore invests in NEWater and desalination because the water agreement with Johor ends in 2061, and there is no guarantee it will be renewed or extended. Relying on imported water therefore poses a supply risk. NEWater treats used water and desalination turns seawater into drinking water, both within Singapore, so they do not depend on rainfall or on another country. However, these methods require significant energy, making them more expensive and carbon-intensive.
